executiveSummary: Exposed single-replica Grafana without autoscaling is the clearest availability risk in this snapshot.

confidenceLimiters: Probe behavior still needs workload-specific validation before any rollout.
Runtime telemetry is confirmed, but root-cause verification still needs live metrics and events.

keyFindings.title: Exposed single-replica workload without HPA: gosell-test/prometheus-grafana
keyFindings.whyItMatters: A single exposed pod is a hard single point of failure during node drains, evictions, or rollout churn.

keyFindings.title: 9 container(s) missing readiness/liveness probes
keyFindings.whyItMatters: Without probes, Kubernetes can route traffic to unhealthy pods and self-healing becomes much less reliable.

evidence.signal: missing probe(s): deploy gosell-test/prometheus-grafana container=grafana readiness=false liveness=false
discovered platform API groups: monitoring.coreos.com, metrics.k8s.io
service exposure inventory: ClusterIP=18 NodePort=0 LoadBalancer=1 ExternalName=0

likelyRootCauseHypotheses.description: The highest current availability risk comes from a statically scaled exposed workload rather than from an active crash loop.

contradictoryOrMissingEvidence.signal: Need service and endpoint verification to confirm current traffic path and readiness.

whatToVerifyNext: Confirm the Service selects the Grafana pod and currently has ready endpoints.
Check whether the Grafana deployment can safely run more than one replica.

immediate.title: Verify Grafana exposure path and scale from 1 to 2 replicas if the workload is stateless enough
immediate.expectedBenefit: Removes the most obvious single point of failure without depending on probe correctness.
immediate.riskTradeoff: If the workload has singleton assumptions or storage constraints, scale-out may be unsafe until validated.
immediate.rollbackOutline: Scale back to one replica and revert the deployment spec if multi-replica behavior is not safe.

preventive.title: Add readiness and liveness probes for the affected workloads after validating endpoints and startup behavior
preventive.expectedBenefit: Improves safe traffic routing and self-healing.
preventive.riskTradeoff: Incorrect probes can cause self-inflicted outages during rollout.
preventive.rollbackOutline: Revert or relax probe configuration if rollout stability regresses.

proposedOperatorMessage: Kube Ops Copilot: exposed single-replica Grafana without autoscaling is the clearest availability risk in this snapshot. Best next action is to confirm the Service/endpoints path and, if safe, scale to two replicas with operator approval.
hiddenRisks: Probe omission may look harmless during calm periods but increases partial-failure risk during dependency incidents.
A graceful-looking cluster can still be one node drain away from user-visible downtime when an exposed workload has only one replica.
unknowns: Grafana multi-replica safety still needs validation against storage/session assumptions.
finalOperatorVerdict: Reduce the exposed Grafana single point of failure first, then address probe gaps as a staged hardening task.
